after school, but maybe I'm a little early?)

(Huh? What's going on?
Akimizu isn't here yet...)

(It's already ten minutes past
our meeting time, but...)

(Did I get the meeting place wrong?
Even so, I've got no idea where else to go...)
(I'll wait just a little longer...)
(She's not coming... I wonder why...)

(If she's not coming, there's nothing for it.

...m sor... ...ryyy
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Yuu shouting gomen nasai from far away, only fragments audible.

rows.en: I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorry...

I was just about to give up and go out
on my own, so I'm glad you made it.
I never thought I'd be this late...
Did something happen?

Yeah.
Right as I left the classroom, Gary-sensei
asked me to run an errand for him...
Ah, I see, so that's why...

And right after I finished that,
Claire-senpai stopped me and lectured me
about the way I wear my uniform...
Oh, that too...

So then I was hurrying to the school gate
when Yui-chan asked me to help her out
with modding her EX-Gear...

When I finally got out of the building,
Luis-san explained all sorts of things
to me about "Tomorrow's Sky"...
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Asu no Sora, in book-title quotes in the Japanese; not in the glossary.

rows.en:
And that's why I was late.
I'm really sorry.
No, I totally understand why.

When someone asks me for something,
I just can't say no...
Um, I get it now, so let's head out.
Oh, that's right!

Things were hectic, but we managed
to finish the errand somehow...

I'm really sorry about today.
I'll make it up to you properly next time...

No, don't worry about it.
I'm not bothered either.

Oh, look at the time! I have to get home!
See you!
Yeah, see you tomorrow!
(Akimizu's surprisingly... huh...)
rows.notes: Male. The Japanese deliberately leaves out the adjective; kept unfinished.
